description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.
Light version of an Armorjack for your head. No armor penalty.

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 24 hours.

  • The user rolls 2d6 Humanity Loss which is returned if they pass the Secondary Effect save
  • The user ignores Seriously Wounded wound states for the duration

Secondary Effect (DV17)

When the dose wears off, the user rolls WILL + Resist Torture/Drugs + 1d10 against Secondary DV.

  • On Fail Humanity loss is not returned
  • Unless experiencing the primary effect, REF -2
A cybernetical replacement leg. Comes with a free foot.

Cost: 250eb (Expensive) ♦ Install: Clinic

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

Adds kinetic actuators to leg internals, allowing for a “double jump.”

Cyberleg Option. Once per Round when the user jumps at least 4m/yds, the distance traveled can be increased by 2m/yds in any direction, including up. Requires two Cyberlegs and must be paired.

Type: Cyberleg
Install: Clinic
Option Slots: uses 1
